claim: Blood stacks space three ways: plain plan overlap (37 of 43 campaign maps), room-over-room links where one must see from one into the other, and decks of blocking floor-aligned sprites (37 maps; 34 use both). Our reading is that the choice is forced by what lies below: enclosed over enclosed can be plan overlap, but a sector over an open volume cannot be separated from it in z, so a deck over open space is sprites. BB4's regular grammar: 32,768 z of clear height per layer (1.93 bodies), an 8,192 slab, 40,960 floor to floor.
evidence: tools/mine_layers.py, knowledge/blood/design/layers-v1.json technique_usage (2026-08-28): blocking_floor_aligned_sprite 37 maps (0.8605), plan_overlap 37, both 34; BB4 has 71 sectors, 68 plan overlaps and no z clash.
use: Pick the technique by what lies below; take storey heights from BB4's grammar.
